I answered Tobias in a thread under his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the depot was **Southgate**.

That comes from Pree Sundaram's posts in that channel on 2025-09-03. She said label printing had stalled across Tansley Parcel depots during the carrier API outage, and that Southgate dispatch had totes stacked beside door 4. At 18:43 she closed the incident and said Southgate had cleared the backlog.

Tobias is a member of that channel, so everything in the reply is something he can already read there.
